correctness.rationale: The claim fixes the Yamaguchi--Tajima three-parameter qutrit unitary model, real r=(p-q)/(p+q) in (0,1), kappa=4(p-q)^2/(p+q), and weights G=kappa diag_block(W,h) with W=[[a,c],[c,b]] positive definite (D=ab-c^2>0) and h>0. From the source's exact inverse beta-QFI, the upper 2x2 real correction X must obey X>=0 and det X>=beta^2 r^2; conversely those are precisely the upper Hermitian PSD block conditions. Weighted trace AM-GM gives tr(W X)>=2 sqrt(det W * det X)>=2 beta r s for s=sqrt D, attained at X_beta=beta r s W^{-1}; the independent third constraint is kappa V33>=1-beta^2 r^2 and is simultaneously tight. Thus exact fixed-beta cost is a+b+h+2 beta r s-h beta^2 r^2. Its supremum on 0<=beta<1 occurs at beta*=s/(hr) when s<hr and at beta->1^- when s>=hr, giving the stated two formulas. A single V feasible for ALL beta must satisfy det X>=r^2 and kappa V33>=1; both bounds are simultaneously attained by X*=r s W^{-1}, kappa V33=1, whose 2x2 determinant of the Hermitian slack equals r^2(1-beta^2)>=0 and whose third slack is beta^2 r^2>=0. This proves exact Holevo=a+b+h+2rs, with strictly positive gap hr^2 in boundary branch and s(2hr-s)/h in interior branch. At s=hr, both formulas match; at s>0, h>0, 0<r<1 no degeneracy. Read verifier file to check which assertions it actually tests; analytically checked the matrix conditions and both branches, not merely its dense beta grid.
